exercises.name: Dumbbell hammer curl
exercises.cues: Neutral grip (thumbs up), elbows pinned to sides, curl to ~90 deg and above.

exercises.name: Plate-pinch wrist rotation (supination/pronation)
exercises.cues: Elbow at 90 deg pinned to side; pinch plate rim with fingertips; rotate from plate hanging vertical to flat on upturned palm and back.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell reverse curl
exercises.cues: Overhand grip (moderate confidence), elbow pinned, curl hip to shoulder; free hand on stomach. PiP inset shows front angle.

exercises.name: Seated cable wrist curl
exercises.cues: Sit at end of bench, lean forward, forearms over knees, underhand grip; only wrists move - curl up, lower into extension.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell reverse concentration curl
exercises.cues: Back of upper arm braced on inner thigh, overhand grip, curl from near floor to chest/shoulder, lower slowly; free hand on knee.

exercises.name: Standing single-arm cable reverse curl
exercises.cues: Stand side-on to cable, overhand grip, elbow pinned at side, curl thigh to chest, control the lowering.

videos.title: Struggling to build your forearms? Then do this...

exercises.name: Reverse curls
exercises.cues: Standing, overhand grip, curl both dumbbells to chest, elbows by sides.

exercises.name: Iso curls (hanging wrist lever)
exercises.cues: Arm straight at side, neutral grip; only the wrist moves, tilting the front of the dumbbell up and down.

exercises.name: Inner wrist curls
exercises.cues: Elbows bent 90 deg at sides, palms up, curl wrists up.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.cues: Jog in place, heels to glutes, hands behind back.

exercises.name: Bounce with alternating uppercuts/overhead punches
exercises.cues: Light bounce on toes, punch up alternately.

exercises.name: High-knee taps
exercises.cues: Palms down at waist height, drive knees up to touch them.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks + cross-body front kicks
exercises.cues: Mix jacks with kicking leg up to opposite hand.

exercises.name: Standing cross-body knee-to-elbow crunch
exercises.cues: Hands behind head, bring knee to opposite elbow, alternate.

videos.title: If you are over 30 years old, do these exercises

exercises.name: Drooping eyelid technique
exercises.cues: Fingertips lift the brow/upper-eye skin upward.

exercises.name: Inter-brow wrinkle technique
exercises.cues: Fingers across forehead press and smooth skin between brows apart.

exercises.name: Nasolabial fold exercise
exercises.cues: Fingers pressed along sides of nose/cheeks while lifting chin and looking up.

videos.title: School starts at 8:00 / Me at 7:60 (German face-exercise app)
videos.protocol: 60 s per move with short rests (app timer)

exercises.name: Chew upward (Nach oben kauen)
exercises.cues: Head tilted back looking up, chewing motion.

exercises.name: Chin tuck (Kinn einziehen)
exercises.cues: Pull head straight back along a vertical line.

exercises.name: Lion face (Loewe)
exercises.cues: Mouth wide, tongue out, eyes wide.

exercises.name: Alternate cheek puffs (Wangen abwechselnd aufblasen)
exercises.cues: Puff air into one cheek then the other.

exercises.name: Hyoid stretch (Zungenbeindehnung)
exercises.cues: Hands crossed flat on collarbones, tilt head back, then forward.

exercises.name: Full-face massage (Ganzgesichtsmassage)
exercises.cues: Palms sweep from jaw up over cheeks to forehead and temples.

videos.title: Glow up tips for boys / Practice hunter eyes

exercises.name: Moisten face
exercises.cues: Spray water on face.

exercises.name: Nose-side upward slides
exercises.cues: V-fingers slide up both sides of the nose to inner eye corners.

exercises.name: Brow strokes with forehead anchor
exercises.cues: One palm anchors forehead, other fingers stroke brow up/out.

exercises.name: Under-eye outward sweeps
exercises.cues: Fingers sweep along nose/under eyes outward.

exercises.name: Brow-to-temple slides
exercises.cues: Index fingers across brows slide out to temples.

exercises.name: Temple circles
exercises.cues: Fingertip circles at temples/outer eye.

exercises.name: Temple lift
exercises.cues: Fingertips pull temples up and back, eyes closed.

exercises.name: Outer-eye corner lift
exercises.cues: V-fingers frame one eye and lift the outer corner upward.

exercises.name: Mewing / jaw exercise sequence
exercises.cues: Pursed lips -> mouth wide open -> teeth clenched and bared -> head tilted fully back (neck/jaw stretch) -> side profile with tongue on palate.

exercises.name: Chair toe-tap with overhead reach
exercises.cues: Alternately lift a foot onto the chair seat and drive the knee while reaching arms overhead and pulling down.

exercises.name: Standing oblique knee-to-elbow
exercises.cues: Hands behind head, raise knee toward elbow, alternate.

exercises.name: Kneeling incline push-up on chair
exercises.cues: Kneel, hands on chair seat edge, lower chest to seat and press up.

exercises.name: Chair-supported hip thrust
exercises.cues: Upper back on seat, arms crossed on chest, drive hips to tabletop.

exercises.name: Chair triceps dips
exercises.cues: Hands on seat edge behind, knees ~90 deg, bend elbows to lower, press up.

videos.title: Kneeling core routine (50 reps each, daily)

exercises.name: Kneeling alternating heel touches
exercises.cues: Tall kneel, reach one hand back to same-side heel while the other arm sweeps up; alternate.

exercises.name: Kneeling side bend / reach
exercises.cues: Upright kneel, slide hand down side of thigh toward floor.

exercises.name: Kneeling oblique crunch
exercises.cues: Hands behind head, crunch elbow toward hip each side.

exercises.name: Kneeling alternating floor taps
exercises.cues: From tall kneel, tap floor beside knee while other arm sweeps overhead; alternate.

exercises.name: Kneeling hip hinge
exercises.cues: Sit hips back toward heels, then drive hips forward to tall kneel.

exercises.name: Standing alternating knee drive / lunge-to-knee
exercises.cues: Step back and drive the knee up to hip height.
